title: LUXOAK Full Size Lift Up Storage Bed with Charging Station | Storage Headboard, Wood Platform Bed Frame, Underneath Storage Space, No Box Spring Needed, Easy Assembly, Black
features: GAS LIFT STORAGE BED- With gas lifting mechanism, you can lift bed frame with mattress up easily to use the ample underneath storage space, saving suitcases, storage bags or out-season bedding and clothes, keeping your room clean and tidy.

STORAGE HEADBOARD WITH CHARGING STATION- Featured 2 Outlets & 2 USB Ports on headboard, it's convenient to plug in phone, tablet or lamp any time, it's also practical to store books, decorations or a clock within your reach.

NO BOX SPRING NEEDED- Storage bed frame made of 12 solid wood slats & strong metal construction can easily support mattress without the need of box spring. No worries about the mattress sliding with the protective device back the frame.
EASY TO ASSEMBLE- Clearly instructions, labeled parts, slats with snap-fit design, two people can assemble this bed frame within 30 mins.

BEST SPACE SAVING for small homes or apartments with limited space. Its storage space is more than double that of ordinary storage beds. Featured retro wood design, this platform bed suits for any room styles.
